name: io.github.pournasserian/mcp-my-site
title: mcp-my-site
description: Search and fetch tools for one website, served from an index you build with the mcpmysite crawler.

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: Publish the server's port 8080 on the host.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Mount the index folder built by `mcpmysite build` into the container.

index_dir.description: Absolute path of the index folder on the host.

environmentVariables.name: Index__Path
environmentVariables.description: Folder inside the container that holds the index, the target of the mount above.

environmentVariables.name: AI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the embeddings provider, needed only to serve a hybrid index. Leave it unset for a keyword-only index.
